# Bone fragments

Type: Material | Internal ID: BoneFragments | Source: Skeleton, ,, Rancid remains, ,, Skugg | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Bone fragments is an item.

## Availability

• Dropped by Skeletons and Rancid remains found in Burial Chambers, as well as commonly inside Troll Caves, both in the Black Forest biome.
• Can be found while mining Stone Graves and Viking Graveyards in the Meadows.
• Can be found by destroying bones surrounding Tar pits in the Plains.
• Can also be found in the Sunken Crypts in Swamp biomes.
• Dropped by destroyed Skugg.

Categorias: Materials
